verdict.rationale: Sierra's docs describe a voice agent that replaces IVR menus, uses memory and customer context, and delivers real-time resolutions. It can take card and ACH payments over the phone and speaks 55+ languages. A build-once, deploy-across-chat-and-phone model implies the same knowledge and actions as chat. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of voice quality, and explicit documentation of knowledge and action parity between voice and chat beyond the marketing line.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent handles phone calls — speech in, speech out — with the same knowledge and actions as chat

citations.quote: Build once and deploy across any channel—chat, phone, email, SMS, and messaging.
Replace rigid IVR menus with an empathetic voice agent that understands customer context, leverages memory for personalized experiences, and delivers accurate, real-time resolutions
Collect card and ACH payments entirely over the phone with no IVR handoff.
Use Voice Personas to design how your agent sounds, speaks, and connects
